title: Terrorist hideout dismantled in Indian-administered Kashmir
summary: A terrorist hideout was discovered and dismantled in the Indian-administered region of Jammu and Kashmir, resulting in the seizure of two grenades. The incident has raised concerns about security in the region. Authorities have launched an investigation into the matter.
summary_points: A terrorist hideout was found in the Indian-administered region of Jammu and Kashmir
Two grenades were seized from the site
The incident has raised concerns about security in the region
title_hi: जम्मू-कश्मीर में आतंकवादी छिपाहट का पता चला, दो ग्रेनेड जब्त
summary_hi: जम्मू-कश्मीर में एक आतंकवादी छिपाहट का पता चला, जिसमें दो ग्रेनेड जब्त की गईं। इस घटना ने सुरक्षा स्थिति में बदलाव लाया। पुलिस ने इस मामले में जांच शुरू कर दी है।
